Patrick Bet-David’s Your Next Five Moves: Master the Art of Business Strategy, written with Greg Dinkin, is built around an attractive idea: successful entrepreneurs should think like chess players. Rather than reacting to whatever problem appears next, they should anticipate consequences, understand the intentions of other players and position themselves several moves ahead.
ads
ads
It is a useful metaphor, but only up to a point.

...

An entrepreneur may plan five moves ahead only to discover that the board itself has changed.
That limitation does not destroy Bet-David’s argument.

...

Bet-David is right that strategy begins with self-knowledge, but self-knowledge is only the beginning. The entrepreneur must eventually negotiate with reality.
